The low shared ends are at bottom-left, strips sweep upward and away towards upper-right. Preserve the three distinct long lifted strips including their broad straight-cut terminal ends, and the lower arched ribbon pieces between them. Trace the source geometry closely. Each piece must remain individually readable through its actual narrow separation and shadow; do not fuse them into a blob, add circular roof holes, round off the cut ends or invent extra fins. Keep the view looking down from the same side and height as this image.

Dense soft gray fog drifts among distant conifers, softly fading background, overcast diffuse daylight. Retain the source's portrait framing and complete model silhouette.

Avoid shiny CGI, manicured velvet grass, patterned texture repetition, dramatic cinematic sun rays, oversharpening, fantasy mountain scenery.
Add only a few tiny naturally spaced scale figures: two on the ground path, one or two strolling on a broad low gently sloped roof portion, none on the steep raised tips; several naturally separated sheep grazing on surrounding ground. Keep figures secondary to the form.
Single high-detail image. No text, labels, white studio background, borders or watermark.
